scope.summary: Implement a whiteboard mode of StudioDocument: an unbounded freeform board surface (StudioBoard container) holding board objects as StudioLayer nodes, distinct from fixed-canvas/artboard and page-spread modes but sharing the SAME document, selection, history/undo (14.19), color, collaboration (14.17), command, and export machinery. A whiteboard document MUST NOT be a separate document type with its own siloed model; it is a mode of the one StudioDocument.
acceptance_criteria: whiteboard mode as StudioBoard over one StudioDocument; shared machinery; no siloed type
proof_targets: board mode over one document; Argus canvas
expected_tests: live: board mode operates over one StudioDocument (shared selection/history/export)
negative: no separate whiteboard document type/model
argus: board canvas reachable by author_id

risk_if_missed: Whiteboard silos into a separate document model; unification broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
